body.name: Equilibrium perfect-intervention derivative
body.construction: \(\tau_{u\to v}^G(\Lambda_G):=e_v^\top(I-\Lambda_{G,-u,-u}^\top)^{-1}\Lambda_{G,u,-u}^\top\) for \(u,v\in V\) with \(u\ne v\), where \(e_v\) and all matrix coordinates on the right-hand side are indexed by \(V\setminus\{u\}\).
